results.title: Suns waive Haywood Highsmith after brief stint
results.description: The Suns are moving on from veteran forward Haywood Highsmith. Phoenix waived Highsmith on Wednesday, according to Michael Scotto of HoopsHype. He had a $3 million salary for the 2026-27 season, with $1 million guaranteed.

results.title: Makhachev Questions Morales's Inactivity Ahead Of Title Shot
results.description: Islam Makhachev has doubts about whether Michael Morales has done enough to warrant the next welterweight title shot. Makhachev defends his 170-pound strap against Ian Garry at UFC 330 this Saturday in Philadelphia, with Morales serving as the official backup.
